request-prompt: Add a prominent floating toggle switch for Dark/Light mode on the main body sidebar next to the expand button so I can easily override the light page template without needing to open the header tools.
goal: I strictly prefer dark mode across all websites I use to reduce eye strain and expect a quick, prominent way to toggle themes on any page.
jobs: I want to learn how to sign up and register for a new Fandom user account
I want to find the direct registration link to create a Fandom account
I want to understand how to customize my viewing preferences, such as switching between dark and light themes
I want to find out how to adjust my Fandom account settings and text size on mobile devices
I want to access other beginner guides to learn how to contribute to wikis and join community discussions
I want to read comments from other users or ask a question about getting started on Fandom
I want to sign in to my existing Fandom account

preference-pairs.a: I am a passive consumer (lurker) who prefers to read wiki content anonymously and rarely registers an account or configures settings.
preference-pairs.b: I am an active contributor who loves setting up personalized profiles, configuring preferences, and editing wikis to feel fully integrated into the community.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer simple, highly-visual guides with screenshots and gallery walkthroughs to quickly learn how to navigate a new interface.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer reading comprehensive, text-dense documentation with deep-dive links to understand the complete technical details of how a system works.

preference-pairs.a: I strictly prefer dark mode across all websites I use to reduce eye strain and expect a quick, prominent way to toggle themes on any page.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer using light mode for maximum readability and contrast under normal lighting, and I usually stick with whatever default aesthetic a site provides.
